correctness.rationale: Four-state subset recognizer has up to 2^4-4=12 distinguishable reachable states after singleton collapse. Source original verify.py checks all 4^8=65536 ordered letter pairs by reachable-subset minimization and independently by distinguishability table-filling, confirms only maximal pairs have one 4-cycle letter plus one rank-three letter. Independently implemented a separate subset partition-refinement engine over all 65536, confirming complete state complexity histogram, exact 1536 at sc12, normalized rank-three 128/16 antipodal iff split, and 32 classes of orbit size48. Numerical exhaustion is genuinely complete for fixed 4-state finite set, not an infinite inference.
